entry.title: Standardizing an exposure classification for existing outputs (pre-BIP)
entry.summary: The email emphasizes the importance of aligning classification categories with specific user actions in wallet applications, highlighting that such integration enhances usability from a user's viewpoint. Although the sender admits to lacking expertise to critique the deeper technical aspects, they affirm the appropriateness of the user-facing elements of the project. Furthermore, they commit to contributing their perspective on the user-interface side to the peer review (PR) process. This perspective could potentially influence how features are designed and implemented to ensure they meet practical user needs effectively.
